provenance.question: with the hypothesis class held fixed, does the relaxed LP's structure beat a plain supervised reweighting?
provenance.hypothesis_class: c_ij = sum_k theta_k (a_ik - b_jk)^2, theta on the simplex, same standardised descriptors (K=13) in every arm
provenance.arms: row_softmax (one-sided CE), rowcol_softmax (Sinkhorn CE, both marginals), entropic_iot (entropic joint master), relaxed_lp (regret master), uniform (label-free reference)
provenance.selection: tau in {0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5} and rel_eps in {0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5} chosen on VALIDATION pairs from the TRAINING subjects; the relaxed LP is simplex-only and has no hyperparameter
provenance.solver: row_softmax / rowcol_softmax: torch autograd on a softmax parameterisation, Adam; entropic_iot: SLSQP from iot.entropic.joint_reference; relaxed_lp: the regret loop (CuPDLPx)
provenance.metric: geodesic error on the target, normalised by sqrt(surface area) -- identical to the main study
provenance.memory: n=2000 keeps the entropic arm's (m*m*K) feature tensor at 416 MB; at n=6890 it would be 4.9 GB
